general.clockDuration_one: This test lasts {{count}} minute. The clock at the top of the test screen shows the time left.
general.clockDuration_other: This test lasts {{count}} minutes. The clock at the top of the test screen shows the time left.
general.clockUntimed: This test has no time limit.
general.clockEnd: When the clock reaches zero, the test ends by itself and the answers you have saved are submitted. You do not have to press {{submit}}.
general.clockSubmitLocked: The {{submit}} button stays off until the time is up.
general.clockSubmitEarly: You can also press {{submit}} to end the test before the time is up.
general.sectionClockStrict: Each section also has its own clock. When it reaches zero, the next section opens by itself, and a choice you have not saved on the open question is lost.
general.questionClockStrict: Each question also has its own clock. When it reaches zero, the next question opens by itself, and a choice you have not saved is lost.
general.paletteIntro: The palette beside the question shows a number for every question in the open section. Its shape and colour tell you the state of that question:
general.paletteIntroPaper: The palette beside the question shows a number for every question of the test, across all subjects. Its shape and colour tell you the state of that question:
general.paletteCollapse: The small arrow on the edge of the palette hides it to give the question more room; press it again to bring the palette back.
general.moveJump: Click a number in the palette to go straight to that question.
general.moveSections: Click a section name in the bar above the question to open that section, when the test lets you move between sections.
general.moveNoSave: Going to a question this way does not save the answer on the screen you leave.
general.moveBackNext: {{back}} and {{next}} open the previous or the next question without saving the answer on screen.
general.answerPickStrict: Choose an option, or enter a number, to answer. Your choice is not saved until you press one of the save buttons below.
general.answerPickPractice: Choose an option, or enter a number, to answer. Your choice is saved as soon as you make it.
general.saveNextStrict: {{saveNext}} saves your answer and opens the next question.
general.saveMarkReview: {{saveMarkReview}} saves your answer, marks the question for review and opens the next question.
general.markReviewNext: {{markReviewNext}} marks the question for review, saves any answer you have chosen and opens the next question. A marked question that has an answer is counted when the test is scored.
general.clearResponse: {{clearResponse}} removes the answer to the question on screen.
general.sectionEnd: After the last question of a section, the next question is the first one of the following section.
general.changeAnswer: To change a saved answer, open the question again, make a new choice and press {{saveNext}}.
general.numericStrict: {{label}} questions take a number as the answer. Enter it with the keypad on the screen; the computer keyboard does not work in the answer box.
general.numericPractice: {{label}} questions take a number as the answer. Enter it with the keypad on the screen, or type it.
general.multiple: Where more than one option can be correct, select every option you think is correct.
general.roughPaper: Keep rough paper and a pen ready. The test screen has no space for rough work.
general.calculator: A calculator opens from the calculator icon at the right end of the bar above the sections.
general.fullScreen: The test runs in full screen. Leaving full screen or switching to another tab or window is recorded, and repeated warnings can submit your test for you.
general.disclaimer: This is a practice screen laid out like a computer-based exam. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any exam body.

brief.title: Instructions
brief.readCarefully: Read the following carefully before you begin.
brief.sectionSwitchYes: You can move between sections at any time during the test.
brief.sectionSwitchNo: Sections open one after another; once you move on from a section you cannot return to it.
brief.preview: Before answering starts, you get some time to read through the paper.
brief.noTestInstructions: Your institute has not added any other instructions for this test.
brief.declaration: I have read and understood the instructions. I will not use unfair means during this test. I understand that leaving full screen is recorded and can submit my test, and that the test should be finished in one sitting once it starts.
brief.tickToBegin: Tick the box above to begin.
